[1/2] Plan: adopt and price the in-flight 8-query value-accumulation tile in block prefill attention; baseline vs experiment at 2048/4096 on f32 and f16 KV; drop the temporary TGE_GQA_CHUNKS spike unless it earns a retune

impact_assessment.why: A prior session left an unrecorded value-tile edit and a TGE_GQA_CHUNKS env spike in the working tree; G-001/G-002 require a baseline, a measured verdict and a log entry before continuing.
impact_assessment.benefits: The tile keeps 8 x head_dim accumulators in L1 (2-4 KiB) instead of the 128-token block working set (~32-64 KiB); if pass-2 output traffic is the bottleneck it is a free, bit-identical prefill gain.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: ids and fidelity must stay bit-identical; dependency: block attention kernel only; concurrency: per-head stack scratch 8 x head_dim; state: tile re-streams each value row once per 8-query tile, so large blocks may lose bandwidth.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Same-source baseline and experiment binaries, interleaved same-binary pairs at 2048/4096 on f32 and f16, ids parity, block differential test, full 146-case suite, revert on no consistent win.
